preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract to call the `setVault` function.

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the `setVault` function with the zero address (`0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000`) as the `vault_` argument. This misconfiguration will set the `_vault` state variable to the zero address. Consequently, any functions protected by the `onlyVault` modifier, such as `mint` in the `SapToken` contract, will become permanently unusable because the check `_vault == msg.sender` will always fail.
